topic.title: Abort, Restart, or Continue In-Progress Git Operations

body.p: To abort, restart, or continue an in-progress Git operation, use the conflict panel on Git Staging.

fig.title: Git Staging view during a cherry-pick conflict

body.p: To abort an in-progress operation, go to the conflict panel and select Abort Operation.
To continue to the next commit during a rebase operation, select Continue Rebase.
To restart a merge operation, select Restart Merge.
During a merge, the conflict panel remains visible even after all conflicts are resolved and staged, so you can still abort or restart the merge before committing.
